config.credit_line_rule: a present node attempts a play while its holding is at least the stake less the line; 1s and 4s are one and four stakes; unbounded has no line
config.readouts: top10 and gini on max(holdings, 0), debt reported separately; gain shares on net holdings
config.zero_line: not run; A41-5 runs seed 0's naive cells with a line of zero against a41_same_ticket.json

criteria.detail: Holds: all 72 of seed 0's naive cells, run with a line of zero through the first block's readout and record writer, equal the first block's record in all 105 fields of every cell.
criteria.name: A41-5  with a line of zero the credit arm reproduces the first block's record on seed 0's naive cells, field by field

criteria.detail: Closes on all 1080 cells: the drift relative to the stock is at most 1e-09 on every one.
criteria.name: A41-6  the claim total the module tracks equals holdings plus parked at the end of every cell

criteria.detail: Holds on all 1080 cells: no play above a cap; stops, absences and plays add up to the cap on every node and round (the naive rule abstains from nothing); no play from a node that had left when the round opened; no play from a holding below the stake less the line; no node that played is left below minus the line by more than 1e-09; no idle node moved; no more wins than plays; every settlement equals the stake times wins less losses to within 1e-09; every cell recorded rounds 50 to 299.
criteria.name: A41-7  the credit line, the caps and who is still in hold on every recorded attempt

criteria.detail: Holds: over 1080 cells and 3 class pairs the three terms miss the gap by at most 1e-12 of it; plays per node times return per play misses the counted result per node by at most 1e-12; the counted result misses the ledger's by at most 1e-09; no pair-cell carries a price term, where every class faces one price and the term must be exactly zero
criteria.name: A41-8  the decomposition is an identity and ties to the ledger
